title: Border Patrol finds 68 people hidden in two Laredo-area smuggling stops
excerpt: Border Patrol agents found 33 people in a hidden compartment in a tractor-trailer on Oct. 22 and 35 more in a hollowed-out generator box on a flatbed on Oct. 13, according to KGNS.
content:
Border Patrol agents found 68 people hidden in vehicles in two separate Laredo-area smuggling stops in October, according to KGNS, which reported both cases on Friday.

In the more recent stop, on October 22, a Border Patrol canine team helped agents find 33 people inside a hidden compartment in a tractor-trailer in Laredo. The driver, a U.S. citizen, was arrested and faces federal prosecution, according to the agency. All 33 people found inside were also arrested and face federal illegal-entry charges and removal proceedings, Border Patrol said.

In the earlier stop, around 6 a.m. on October 13, agents found 35 people inside a locked compartment on a flatbed in the Laredo ranchlands. What looked like a generator box had been hollowed out to hide them, agents said. The driver faces federal human-smuggling charges, and the 35 people found inside will be processed for deportation, according to Border Patrol.

Neither report named the people found or the drivers, and neither gave the nationalities, ages or genders of those involved. The exact location of the October 22 tractor-trailer stop was not disclosed.

Sources:

  • KGNS, "Canine team helps Border Patrol find 33 people in tractor-trailer," November 13, 2026
  • KGNS, "Border Patrol says agents found 35 people inside locked compartment on flatbed in Laredo ranchlands," November 13, 2026
